meaning: The reviewed Candidate A persistent-stdio profile cannot satisfy the frozen 8192-byte cumulative preparation stdout requirement. The rejection follows from a conservative lower bound of at least 8821 bytes; no actual class size, kernel identity encoding or complete writer inventory is required.

failure_end_cases.cleanup_preemption: The cleanup barrier suppresses success immediately but does not close a pending ordinary response ledger. Its complete response suffix still belongs to the failed effect attempt, even if physically delivered after the barrier. Cleanup exchanges have their own ledger.
failure_end_cases.early_failure: A materialization failure/rejection or a later admission/compilation failure cannot wait for a nonexistent successful compile response. Apply the no-pending or pending-response case to the failed admitted operation; no second attempt or new counter is allowed.
failure_end_cases.loss_or_deadline: No terminal response is fabricated. Any still-unobserved ordinary suffix is unresolved, not an outside-budget exemption; the failed epoch cannot reopen or publish success. Mandatory cleanup remains independently bounded.
failure_end_cases.no_response_pending: Recorded irrevocable terminal attempt-abort event when no admitted ordinary operation response remains pending.
failure_end_cases.overflow: Overflow fails the attempt, never resets or forgives observed bytes; retain an exceeded/incomplete result and bounded partial/drain evidence. It never authorizes unbounded buffering, a late successful receipt or denial of mandatory independent cleanup.
failure_end_cases.response_pending: First of: final byte of the last terminal ordinary response already admitted to this attempt; observed terminal channel closure/loss; original 10000ms hard preparation deadline. Count every observed partial/invalid ordinary byte until that event.

capture_interval.membership_rule: All ordinary effect request/response frames and any current observation invoked after origin but before the effect endpoint are members. Include actual framing in its own physical stream. Separately identifiable cleanup control/results retain cleanup membership even during preemption; pending ordinary bytes cannot be relabeled.
capture_interval.no_deadline_extension: The shared 5000ms attempt deadline is never renewed. Cancellation/reaping/capture closure and terminal drain remain clamped to original 10000ms hard bound; a failed result never appends a new preparation interval.
capture_interval.no_evidence_deferral: Every mandatory materialization/compile record must be complete in its own response before the endpoint. No chunking, delayed suffix, post-end receipt, observation or handoff may carry deferred effect response evidence to evade the unchanged cap.
capture_interval.origin_basis: The materialization facet admission opens the one-shot effect attempt; independently, the existing shared deadline also begins there. Initial empty observation/request/response precede this effect boundary. Inner final local admission and first response byte are not new origins.
capture_interval.start: Preparation owning boundary records the authenticated single-operation admission for this attempt's already-spent original materialization facet, before dispatching the MATERIALIZE_EXACT_SCENARIO_SOURCE request. That admission record is the single counter-origin event: open both counters at zero there, before any request or response byte of this exchange. Facet spending precedes the record; no cross-owner atomic transaction is claimed.
capture_interval.successful_end: The final physical byte of the complete terminal COMPILE_EXACT_SCENARIO response frame is captured by the owning boundary, including all actual framing and its entire mandatory workspace_state, compiler_identity, capture_and_reap and class_metadata. A successful attempt requires the complete valid COMPLETE response; child exit, payload parsing before frame completion, receipt authentication, new readiness OBSERVE request/response, handoff admission and cleanup completion are not this endpoint.

writer_lower_profile.monotonicity: Each additional mandatory truthful writer/process/task/handle record contributes nonnegative canonical JSON bytes, plus separators where applicable. No removal, replacement or deduplication is authorized. The full encoding is at least the retained lower-topology encoding.
